metadata.dataset_title: Preprocessed Historical Sentinel-2 L2A Surface Reflectance Observations (Telangana Sept 2024 Monsoon Depression)
metadata.source: ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI Level-2A (10m B04 Red & B08 NIR Surface Reflectance)
metadata.processing_note: Cached historical observations with explicit band values and acquisition timestamps. Used when live Google Earth Engine access is unavailable.

FIELD001.source_attribution: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (Tile T44QKE, Warangal) — Preprocessed Historical Archive
FIELD001.limitations: Optical NDVI measures canopy greenness decline (-0.3846 drop), which indicates severe vegetation stress following heavy rainfall. Final crop yield loss percentage requires authorized field officer verification.

FIELD002.source_attribution: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (Tile T44QLE, Khammam) — Preprocessed Historical Archive
FIELD002.limitations: Satellite NDVI decline reflects root-zone waterlogging and canopy stress. Distinguishing permanent plant mortality from temporary wilting requires physical inspection.

FIELD003.reason: Persistent >85% cloud cover over Tile T44QKE/QJE during post-event Sentinel-2 passes; no cloud-free optical imagery available.
FIELD003.limitations: Cloud-free Sentinel-2 optical imagery is unavailable for the post-event window. Assessment relies strictly on Open-Meteo precipitation and temperature records without fabricating NDVI values.
